decisions.decision: It was decided to pass over the van revolving account article at town meeting because how to fund the new van is still in negotiations.

decisions.decision: The board supported the Eagle House Senior Center's new hours of operation starting July 1, 2011 (Tuesday 8AM-6:30PM, Friday 8AM-12:30PM).
decisions.quote: the coa board supported this change.

decisions.decision: The Director will interview the candidates for the Fitchburg State University intern position.

decisions.decision: The date for the COA BBQ/Volunteer Recognition Ceremony will be set after staff vacation times are established.

decisions.decision: The slate of FY12 officers presented by Joyce Wass (Pete Lincoln, Chairperson; Mary Lynn Conrad, Vice-Chairperson) will be voted on at the COA Annual meeting in June.
decisions.quote: this will be voted on at the coa annual meeting in june.

decisions.decision: A copy of the approved bylaw changes will be sent to the Town Clerk.
decisions.quote: a copy of the changes will be sent to the town clerk.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sue Doherty developed a monthly COA budget page with corrections from the previous month and distributed it to board members for review.
budget_items.quote: sue doherty had developed a monthly coa budget

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The COA FY12 budget passed at the May town meeting, including money for more kitchen hours and a second Outreach Coordinator.
budget_items.quote: included in the budget were monies for more hours in the kitchen and ten hours for a second outreach coordinator.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Repair of two air hole leaks in the Eagle House sprinkler system from the ice storm is being pursued, and the facilities manager is checking whether insurance will cover it.
budget_items.quote: whether or not this will be covered by insurance

budget_items.what_was_recorded: No word had been received on whether the grant for the parking lot had been approved.
budget_items.quote: there has been no word received as of this meeting on whether or not the grant for the parking lot

budget_items.topic: Second van grant from Department of Transportation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Doreen wrote and submitted a grant for a second van to the Department of Transportation in December; MART confirmed the grant was awarded.
budget_items.quote: doreen had written this grant for a second van

budget_items.what_was_recorded: MART's May 12, 2011 letter asked that the new van's driver salary and gasoline be fully funded by the Town and assessed a 45% surcharge for insurance and maintenance; the matter remained unresolved.
budget_items.quote: they would be assessing a 45% surcharge
